Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, I attached a short SOW for the 6-week timeboxed pilot (Helio_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf) and a proposed financial schedule that shows two alternative paths:

1) Accelerator credits: one-off pool of credits applied to inference tokens and embeddings; covers peak bursts and measured usage.
2) Engineering hours credit: dedicated block of 80 engineering hours from Redwood CS/Platform for integration and three optimization sprints.

High level: both options get the same SLA and access to our Dedicated trial pool for the period — the difference is how Helio recognizes value internally (billing vs project hours).

Ask: could you confirm which path procurement prefers (credits or hours)? If procurement needs a hybrid (some credits + a smaller hours block) we can map that too.

I included Marissa on the thread to confirm engineering availability and the intake process.

Thanks,

Ben / Marissa —

Attached is a draft addendum redline (Pilot_Addendum_v1_redline.docx) and a short priced table in the Financial_Schedule_v2.xlsx. Key calls I made:

- Credits-only: defined token bucket with conservative burn estimate (baseline + 30% spike allowance). Non-billable internal QA/test runs are excluded from customer billable usage if flagged in request tickets within the pilot window.
- Hours-only (80h block): we propose 60h for integration/optimization + 20h for emergent fixes. Hourly burn rate spelled out with escalation clause for additional hours.
- Hybrid (40h + credits): 40h up front (onboarding sprint + performance tuning) + a smaller credit bucket sized at 60% of credits-only.

I added a short clause for "rollover" in case Helio cannot consume the agreed credits due to product delays: credits expire at the pilot end date but can be converted to a 30-day extended support credit if both parties agree. Legal will need to review the language but this should make procurement comfortable.

Marissa — please confirm the 60h/20h split is realistic and whether we can guarantee a dedicated engineer for the onboarding sprint. If not, we should change the wording to "prioritised engineering allocation" vs guaranteed named engineer.

Kimberly
Director, Contracts & Finance | Redwood Inference

Samira —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the proposed addendum redline and the updated financial schedule (same files copied to this email). Summary of the three options we discussed:

A) Credits-only: conservative token bucket for 6 weeks (baseline + 30% spike). Price: $18,000 for the bucket.
B) Hours-only: 80h block, priced at $220/hr (total $17,600) with scope appendix. 60h dedicated to onboarding/optimisation, 20h for emergent fixes.
C) Hybrid: 40h upfront + credits bucket sized at 60% of A. Price: $10,800 + $11,000 credits = $21,800.

We added an explicit definition of billable engineering time and an optional 30-day conversion clause for unused credits (requires mutual agreement). Kimberly has added a brief IP/confidentiality confirmation and limited liability note — nothing that changes the master agreement materially.

If this looks good, here is the DocuSign link to sign the addendum: https://app.docusign.com/templates/ABC12345-Helio-Pilot-Addendum

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm which option Helio prefers (procurement/finance).
- If hours or hybrid chosen: Marissa will schedule a 60-90 min kickoff to align the onboarding sprint.
- We sign the addendum and set the pilot start date (target: within 5 business days of signature).

Happy to hop on a 15-min call if you want to walk the table together.

Best,
